items.description: The learnings sweep must surface the BullMQ retry diagnosis (dedup_key aa11bb22cc33): a retried job re-runs the whole handler under the same job id, so a non-idempotent send delivers twice — observed as duplicate customer emails after a transient SMTP failure. This is the only store entry that both explains the bug and names the fix shape (record delivery keyed on job.id).
src/queue/worker.ts named as a likely-touched file — the handler whose re-execution is the whole problem.
src/notify/email.ts surfaced as relevant — sendEmail is the side effect that must not repeat.

The reuse inventory must report NO-ANALOGUE for the delivery-record / dedupe store: nothing in the tree persists a per-job delivery marker, and there is no existing idempotency helper to reuse or extend.
change_scope reported as `small` or `medium`. `trivial` understates it (a durable delivery record is new surface); `big` overstates a two-file change.

The store's most keyword-attractive entry (dedup_key bb22cc33dd44, 'every new notification channel must be registered in NOTIFY_CHANNELS') carries deprecated: true, and the contract says to drop deprecated entries. The report must NOT present it as current guidance. Naming it explicitly as deprecated and dropped is not asserting it.
